connectorUiConfig.title: FullHunt Certificates
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: The [FullHunt](https://fullhunt.io) Certificates data connector ingests certificate-derived domain candidates (domains observed in TLS certificates related to your monitored organizations), with first-observed and last-observed times from the [FullHunt Enterprise API](https://docs.fullhunt.io) into Microsoft Sentinel. The data connector is built on the Microsoft Sentinel Codeless Connector Framework.

sampleQueries.description: Latest FullHunt Certificates records (deduplicated by CertificateId)
sampleQueries.query:
FullHuntCertificates_CL
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by CertificateId
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 10

sampleQueries.description: New certificate-derived domains in the last 7 days
sampleQueries.query:
FullHuntCertificates_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by CertificateId
| project TimeGenerated, DomainName, LastSeen

dataTypes.name: FullHuntCertificates_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
FullHuntCertificates_CL
| summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: Read and Write permissions are required.

customs.name: FullHunt Enterprise API key
customs.description: A FullHunt Enterprise account and its API key are required. See the [FullHunt authentication documentation](https://docs.fullhunt.io/authentication).

instructionSteps.title: Connect FullHunt Certificates to Microsoft Sentinel
instructionSteps.description: Copy your API key from your [FullHunt profile settings](https://fullhunt.io/user/settings/), then enter it below and select **Connect**. The connector polls FullHunt every 15 minutes.
